nativeRoute: dapp native Feishu web login / injected DAPP_TOKEN; Superset independently authenticated

loginFlow.steps: Reuse only already authorized host-injected credentials for the matching instance. Legacy normal Feishu web authorization exchanges code and stores identity in a process Session map; its browser anonymous cookie is only a map index, not backend JWT. Separate newer MicroAuth normal OAuth remains separate. Never mint by username to fill a bridge/identity gap.
loginFlow.authorization: Login, token creation/rotation/revocation and business writes require the current task scope; this discovery performs none.

tokenMechanism: Legacy backend Bearer JWT and legacy web process Session are independent source contracts. Existing host-injected DAPP_TOKEN/native Token/API remains supported subject to trusted server caller gate and deployment match; no normal web-session bridge proved. NocoDB xc-token remains independent read-only fallback.
subjectPermission: Legacy trusted minimal server currentcaller endpoint remains unproven; /api/current is absent from audited legacy routers. Browser UI identity or locally decoded JWT is not a native server-bound subject gate. Independently verify Superset identity and target resource permission.
expiryRevoke: 需补 session/generate handler、调用权限、撤销/expiry 与部署 SHA；无证据不提供可直接 mint 的命令。

versionPolicy.rule: Candidate source and published contracts do not establish deployed compatibility. Verify the target instance version and read-only supported capabilities before enabling an adapter.

verification.scope: Read-only documentation/repository discovery; no login, token issuance, credential inspection or business API execution.

sourceMismatch: DATA/dbt legacy auth candidate and DATA/dapp MicroAuth candidate must be matched by instance and deployment. Do not apply Micro-app OAuth to legacy API or treat either candidate as deployed proof.
referenceBase: owner-skill-root for SKILL.md/contractEntrypoints/referenceSources paths; contract field resolves from this JSON directory; upstream repository entrypoints stay repository-relative

sourceBoundaries.legacyNormalWebAuth: Feishu code -> app/user access token -> Feishu userinfo/contact -> process Session map
sourceBoundaries.browserCookie: Anonymous session index only; not an official REST credential by assumption
sourceBoundaries.legacyBackendAuth: Signed JWT Bearer verification -> request.state.username; username-only mint routes are excluded from acceptance
sourceBoundaries.legacySelfIdentity: No /api/current or currentcaller handler in audited legacy auth/router source
sourceBoundaries.slaReadClosure: SLA list -> NocoDB count/page GET candidate; full UI mount/aux closure incomplete, authorization workflow side effects require separate audit
sourceBoundaries.privateHandling: No credential/session bodies, maps or auth errors in output; private stdin/process/SSH injection only after compatible contract and caller gate
sourceBoundaries.cleanup: Record exact application Session logout and task-owned temporary/profile cleanup; do not infer backend Token revocation from browser logout
